invariants.rationale: The method always returns a BulkInsertPartitioner, either via JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner or via JavaBulkInsertInternalPartitionerFactory.get(...).
strategyParams is dereferenced in the method, so it must be non-null for correct execution.
schema is passed as an argument and used in HoodieSchemaUtils.addMetadataFields(schema), so it must be non-null if PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS is present.
If the sort columns strategy param is present, we always return a JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner.
If the sort columns strategy param is not present, we return an instance from JavaBulkInsertInternalPartitionerFactory.get(...), which also implements BulkInsertPartitioner.
